subject: Vendor enrollment — staged legal gates & order form clarifications
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Harper Lee <harper.lee@medisys.com>, Procurement Ops <procure.ops@medisys.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-04-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor enrollment — staged legal gates & order form clarifications

Hi Harper / Procurement team,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. Per our call, I want to propose a staged enrollment approach so we can get vendor records created in your procurement portal (Ariba or Coupa) while legal finalizes the MSA/order form redlines. High-level plan:

1) Registration & KYB: supplier profile, tax form (W-9 or W8), banking details (for invoice routing).
2) Order form signature: agree to commercial terms & PO acceptance SLA.
3) Portal activation: field mapping and PO format (EDI / XML) so POs validate without manual edits.

Open asks from our side to make the portal activation smooth:
- Which portal are you planning to use for this supplier (Ariba network vs Coupa)?
- Preferred PO format: EDI 850, cXML, or a simple XML/CSV export?
- Any PO acknowledgement SLA or PO change process we should map? Typical customers require 24–48h PO ack.
- Do you need a supplier code or will you create one on your side?

I attached a draft order form concessions workbook and a blank MSA redline template for your reference. Once you confirm portal + PO format, our ops team (Marissa) will map fields and share a PO schema for your validation. Kimberly will handle legal redlines on the MSA and the order form exceptions.

Proposed timeline: registration + KYB (2–3 business days), legal sign + order form (3–7 business days depending on redlines), portal mapping & test POs (3–5 business days).

If that looks good, can we get: 1) the procurement portal choice, 2) sample PO (anonymized) and 3) point of contact for EDI/integration?

Thanks — Vivek

--
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0193
From: Harper Lee <harper.lee@medisys.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Ops <procure.ops@medisys.com>
Date: 2025-04-29T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor enrollment — staged legal gates & order form clarifications

Vivek—

Thanks, appreciate the clear plan. Quick answers inline:
- Portal: We prefer to onboard via Coupa for vendor management, but our trading partners team can accept Ariba if necessary. For this supplier we recommend Coupa.
- PO format: Our ERP produces both cXML (preferred) and a flat CSV; we can provide cXML samples. For EDI, we typically use cXML/POXML for Coupa.
- PO ack SLA: Standard is 48 hours for PO acknowledgement and 5 business days for any pricing/line-item disputes.
- Supplier code: We will create the supplier code after KYB.

Attached is our vendor questionnaire (filled) and a redacted cXML sample of a typical PO. Banking/tax info will be provided via our secure vendor portal once we get the registration token from you.

Question for legal: we flagged two order form clauses around invoicing cadence and tax withholding — can your team confirm whether Redwood can accept net-60 on specific govt contracts?

I can introduce you to our EDI engineer (Kiran) if needed — copied Procurement Ops and I will share Kiran’s email after I confirm internally.

Best,
Harper

Harper Lee
Vendor Enablement Manager | Medisys Health
harper.lee@medisys.com
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-04-29T14:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor enrollment — staged legal gates & order form clarifications

Vivek / Marissa —

Thanks for looping me in. I reviewed Harper’s questionnaire and the redacted cXML sample. Preliminary legal notes:

- MSA redlines: I’ve attached MSA_Redline_v3.docx with tracked changes. Key items we should close before signature: liability cap carveouts (customer-specific obligations), data residency/evidence clauses, and an Order Form term that ties PO ack SLA to our delivery/fulfillment milestone.
- Net-60: We can accept net-60 for selected public sector engagements but need approval from finance and a signed order form that enumerates the specific contracts. If Medisys wants net-60 for an identified contract, ask them to flag the account and we’ll route for finance approval.
- Signature routing: DocuSign is fine. Proposed signer matrix: (a) Redwood – VP Revenue (exec signer) for commercial value >$100k, (b) Medisys – Procurement + Legal. We should confirm whether Medisys requires countersignature via their e-sign tool; otherwise DocuSign works.
- PO acknowledgement & change control: we should add a short PO-change control clause to the order form that requires written acceptance for order amendments beyond X% qty/pricing changes (I suggest 10%).

Operational asks for Marissa: please build a one-row exceptions tracker for order form concessions (term, party, justification, approval owner, expiry). I will review and mark whether each concession is approval-by-legal-only or needs finance.

I’m happy to run a quick 30-min sync with Medisys legal if they want to go line-by-line on the redline.

Kimberly

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Harper Lee <harper.lee@medisys.com>, Procurement Ops <procure.ops@medisys.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-04-30T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor enrollment — staged legal gates & order form clarifications

Harper / team —

Thanks for the quick responses and the cXML sample — this is enough for our ops team to start a field-mapping draft. Summary & next steps so we’re all aligned:

Decisions:
- Portal: Coupa confirmed by Medisys.
- PO format: cXML — Marissa will produce a Coupa field map and sample test PO.
- PO ack SLA: 48 hours agreed as baseline. We will add a PO-change control clause (<=10% qty/pricing changes without written acceptance).
- Payment terms: net-60 is possible for specified contracts pending finance sign-off; Harper to flag which account/contract if they want net-60.

Action items & owners:
- Medisys (Harper): confirm Kiran (EDI engineer) contact for test PO exchange and identify any internal e-sign constraints. Due: 2025-05-02.
- Marissa (Redwood Ops): produce Coupa field mapping + sample test PO (cXML) and share SFTP/endpoint details. Due: 2025-05-05.
- Kimberly (Legal): finalize MSA redlines and populate exceptions tracker; indicate finance-needed concessions. Due: 2025-05-06.
- Vivek: coordinate signature routing (DocuSign link ready) and confirm final timeline for activation window.

Attachments included for reference: MSA_Redline_v3.docx, OrderForm_Concessions.xlsx, Medisys_Vendor_Questionnaire.pdf.

If everyone agrees, we’ll kick registration today and aim for a staged rollout: supplier record + KYB (by 2025-05-02), order form signature (target 2025-05-09), portal test POs and activation (target 2025-05-12).

Please reply-all with any concerns or confirmation.

Thanks — Vivek

--
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
